versions.text: Where a UAV System includes any ancillary elements necessary to enable safe flight (such as, for instance, launch and landing elements), Special Conditions in addition to USAR.1581 (a)(2) must be established and agreed with the Certifying Authority to ensure safe operations.

Where a UAS includes any ancillary elements necessary to enable safe flight (such as, for instance, launch and landing elements), Special Conditions in addition to USAR.1581 (a)(2) must be established and agreed with the Certifying Authority to ensure safe operations.
